issues: No integrity problems found. The diff changes only two things: the clip range on the standardized descriptors (±5 to ±3) and the RBF gamma (1/d to 0.5/d). The mean and sd used for standardizing come from the training fold only (dmu and dsd are computed on D), so nothing from the test fold leaks in. There is no file access, no pasted answers and no use of test labels.
No bugs that would make the result meaningless. The train and test kernels are still built the same way and use the same gamma.
Recomputed z: (0.4830 - 0.4799) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) = 0.0031 / 0.0099 ≈ 0.31. This matches the reported 0.306; the small gap is likely rounding of the means.
The gain of 0.003 is well within noise (z ≈ 0.31, one run on each side). Rejecting is consistent with the numbers. If the change is worth keeping, a replicate would be needed.
